label: A2BC4_oP28_60_d_c_2d-002
title: $\alpha$-Li$_{3}$PS$_{4}$ Structure
comments:
Li$_{3}$PS$_{4}$ is known to exist in four forms (Homma, 2011): \begin{itemize} \item $\gamma$-Li$_{3}$PS$_{4}$, the ground state, is stable below 573K in the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB3C4_oP16_31_a_ab_2ab-001}{enargite ($H2_{5}$) structure}. \item \href{current_web_home_dir/A4BC4_oP36_62_acd_c_2cd-001}{$\beta$-Li$_{3}$PS$_{4}$} is stable between 573 and 746K. \item \href{current_web_home_dir/A2BC4_oP28_60_d_c_2d-002}{$\alpha$-Li$_{3}$PS$_{4}$} (this structure) is stable above 746K. \item \href{current_web_home_dir/A3BC4_tP16_114_ad_b_e-001}{$\delta$-Li$_{3}$PS$_{4}$} is a predicted high-pressure phase. \end{itemize} ~ \vspace{-.25in} 
 The astute reader will note that we have left 1/3 of the lithium atoms unaccounted for.  (Homma, 2010) could not find the positions of these atoms.  As Li$_{3}$PS$_{4}$ is a superionic conductor it is possible that these atoms move freely through the structure. 
 Data for this structure was taken at 906K. 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/A2BC4_oP28_60_d_c_2d-001}{CaB$_{2}$O$_{4}$ I} and \href{current_web_home_dir/A2BC4_oP28_60_d_c_2d-002}{$\alpha$-Li$_{3}$PO$_{4}$} have the same AFLOW prototype label, A2BC4\_oP28\_60\_d\_c\_2d. They are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files.
